name: Substance Use Screening
description: Initial screening for alcohol and drug use patterns.

name: Drug Dependency Assessment
description: Assesses dependency, tolerance, and patterns of drug use.

name: Alcohol Dependency Assessment
description: Assesses alcohol use, dependency, and risk behaviours.

name: Recovery Readiness Assessment
description: Measures motivation, readiness, and commitment to recovery.

name: Relapse Risk Assessment
description: Assesses risk factors and triggers for relapse.

name: Harm Reduction Assessment
description: Evaluates harm reduction practices and safety strategies.

name: Family Impact Assessment
description: Assesses the impact of substance use on family functioning.

name: Parenting Capacity and Substance Use Assessment
description: Evaluates how substance use affects parenting capacity and child safety.

name: Dual Diagnosis Assessment
description: Assesses co-occurring mental health and substance use issues.

name: Craving Assessment
description: Measures intensity, frequency, and triggers of cravings.
